articles.title: Crypto’s security nightmare won’t be solved by ordinary audits
articles.snippet: Without an update to the current auditing infrastructure, the crypto space will likely continue to suffer significant losses, explains Beyer.

articles.title: BitGo offers Europe’s crypto firms a MiCA-compliance lifeline as license deadline looms
articles.snippet: BaFin-regulated BitGo says its Crypto-as-a-Service platform can help eligible crypto players across Europe with an alternative way to navigate MiCA.

articles.title: Blockchain.com deepens onchain stock offerings as tokenized equities market grows
articles.snippet: The rollout in collaboration with Ondo Finance broadens access to tokenized traditional assets as demand for onchain stocks and ETFs continues to grow.

articles.title: China pays closer attention to stablecoins as cross-border role expands
articles.snippet: A senior PBOC official called for closer monitoring, stronger regulation and international coordination as stablecoins gain importance in global payments.

articles.title: Bitcoin is setting up 'meaningful floors' in $60K–$70K range: Analyst
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s $60,000–$70,000 cost-basis cluster hints at a bottom, but a bearish daily flag keeps BTC exposed to a deeper selloff toward $50,000.
